reviews.reason: Keep the unauthenticated Home consent identity stable while password sign-in or registration is pending. This prevents destroying the form and aborting its request. The account fields, guest start controls, first-visit consent, tutorial and CPU practice remain unchanged. Authenticated identities still include their access revision, so fresh sign-in checks consent again, including for the same account.
evidence: Compared JA/EN guest starting instructions in src/locales/siteContent.ts, Home/TitleScreen, TermsGate and the actual circuitAccess/useCampaignCloud subscription. No public instructions require a new step or new login provider.

Before the fix, the real Home composition aborted the four-second synthetic password login and returned to entry selection without access. After the fix, check-password-login-browser.mjs passes all nine conditions: delayed password login and registration, incorrect password, outage/retry, persistent reload, leaving a pending request, explicit consent, same-account re-login after returning from a synthetic match, and leaving a delayed consent check.

Related authentication, socket, legacy restoration, consent and campaign tests: seven files / 162 tests PASS. Client typecheck and changed-file lint PASS. Independent read-only review found no required correction and confirmed that Home, TermsGate and useCampaignCloud are not replaced in the regression fixture.

The production-configured Web build PASS. check-public-guides.mjs passes eight initial HTML routes and six desktop/mobile/JA/EN/no-JavaScript conditions with external requests blocked. The synthetic match tests Home navigation and re-login, not live match settlement; the four-second response is simulated, not a measured production latency. No live account, consent, database, rating or payment is written.

reviews.reason: The change fixes an internal React identity while the user is unauthenticated. It does not change article text, public page routes, navigation links, metadata, QUBE teaching, advertising, privacy or sales terms. The public guide and FAQ describe the same guest and account controls. Server proof verification and registered consent are still required before account access and cloud progress.
evidence: Compared the sole production-source change in src/app/page.tsx with SiteInformation, JA/EN siteContent, the public page entry components and TermsGate. The logged-in type/id/revision identity remains intact; unauthenticated access is not granted by this key.

The actual production-configured static export passes check-public-guides.mjs: eight initial HTML routes and six responsive/JA/EN/no-JavaScript conditions. Commerce verification with --sales=on also passes desktop/mobile/JA/EN without runtime errors or overflow. No public article or navigation change was made.

The new real-Home browser regression passes nine conditions, including two fresh consent reads for same-account re-login and no lobby/progress access before explicit required consent. All external transport is synthetic or blocked; no live provider or production account is accessed.
